prompts.title: Welcome to the Shallows
prompts.desktop: The dive is sealed with kelp until you finish the tutorial. Swim to the Tutorial ring on the floor and press F to learn the ropes.
prompts.touch: The dive is sealed with kelp until you finish the tutorial. Swim to the Tutorial ring on the floor and tap Enter to learn the ropes.

prompts.title: Sealed by kelp
prompts.desktop: The kelp holds the dive shut. Finish the tutorial (the ring up in the hall) and it opens for good.
prompts.touch: The kelp holds the dive shut. Finish the tutorial (the ring up in the hall) and it opens for good.

prompts.title: Welcome to the Shallows
prompts.desktop: Swim to the whirlpool in the floor and press F to dive. Press Tab or I (or open the pause menu) to read your journal.
prompts.touch: Swim to the whirlpool in the floor and tap Enter to dive. Tap pause, then Journal, to read your journal.
